@@ -0,0 +1,64 @@
+# This file is part of Ansible
+# GNU General Public License v3.0+ (see COPYING or https://www.gnu.org/licenses/gpl-3.0.txt)
+
+from __future__ import (absolute_import, division, print_function)
+__metaclass__ = type
+
+from units.compat.mock import Mock, call
+
+from ansible.module_utils.facts.hardware.aix import AIXHardware
+
+
+def test_get_cpu_facts():
+    module = Mock()
+    lsdev_output = '\n'.join('proc%d Available 00-00 Processor' % i for i in range(12))
+    lsdev_output += '\nproc12 Defined 00-00 Processor\n'
+    module.run_command.side_effect = [
+        (0, lsdev_output, ''),
+        (0, 'type  PowerPC_POWER7  Processor type  False\n', ''),
+        (0, 'smt_threads  4  SMT threads  True\n', ''),
+    ]
+
+    assert AIXHardware(module).get_cpu_facts() == {
+        'processor': ['PowerPC_POWER7'],
+        'processor_count': 1,
+        'processor_cores': 12,
+        'processor_threads_per_core': 4,
+        'processor_vcpus': 48,
+    }
+    assert module.run_command.call_args_list == [
+        call('/usr/sbin/lsdev -Cc processor'),
+        call('/usr/sbin/lsattr -El proc0 -a type'),
+        call('/usr/sbin/lsattr -El proc0 -a smt_threads'),
+    ]
+
+
+def test_get_cpu_facts_without_smt_threads():
+    module = Mock()
+    module.run_command.side_effect = [
+        (0, 'proc0 Available 00-00 Processor\nproc1 Available 00-01 Processor\n', ''),
+        (0, 'type PowerPC_POWER7 Processor type False\n', ''),
+        (0, '', ''),
+    ]
+
+    assert AIXHardware(module).get_cpu_facts() == {
+        'processor': ['PowerPC_POWER7'],
+        'processor_count': 1,
+        'processor_cores': 2,
+        'processor_threads_per_core': 1,
+        'processor_vcpus': 2,
+    }
+
+
+def test_get_cpu_facts_without_available_processors():
+    module = Mock()
+    module.run_command.return_value = (0, 'proc0 Defined 00-00 Processor\n', '')
+
+    assert AIXHardware(module).get_cpu_facts() == {
+        'processor': [],
+        'processor_count': 1,
+        'processor_cores': 0,
+        'processor_threads_per_core': 1,
+        'processor_vcpus': 0,
+    }
+    module.run_command.assert_called_once_with('/usr/sbin/lsdev -Cc processor')
